notes.title: Patch 1.07: Optimize processes and BGM
notes.notes:
The content of this repair:

1. Optimizing the Easily Stuck Process (Exploration in Chapter Four) :

Now, you won't loop through the cabin N times anymore. Before the conditions are met, you will not be allowed to go out and will be given clues.

2. Unify the loudness of BGM:

Now all the BGM has been aligned in terms of loudness and volume, and there will no longer be any fluctuations in pitch or volume.

3. Fixed a BUG in the plot:

Fixed the timeline BUG of a certain event and improved the story of a certain person.

At present, the malicious bugs in the game have been fixed. Here, we express our sincere gratitude to all the players who provided feedback.

notes.title: The Throne of The Monster release on June 23rd
notes.notes:
Fantasy adventure AVG "The Throne of Monsters"

It is scheduled for official release at 14:00 on June 23, 2025

【 Distribution Platform 】Steam

【 Game Introduction 】 Fantasy adventure x Female perspective x Visual novel

This work integrates the gameplay of "map exploration" and "card battle" on the basis of a "visual novel". As the protagonist, "you" mistakenly entered the capital city shrouded in fog. Only by slaying the hypocritical king on the throne could you leave. Bid farewell to the past and fight against the unknown "monsters"; Face tears and regrets head-on and bring new life to the world.
